sources.snippet: 🧠 Alzheimer Model — MRI Detection with MedSAM + ResNet18 A hybrid deep learning model for classifying Alzheimer's disease stages from MRI scans using MedSAM brain structure segmentation combined with a fine-tuned ResNet18 image classifier. Achieves 97.27% test accuracy on the Alzheimer's MRI Dataset.

sources.title: Explainable AI for Alzheimer's MRI Classification - GitHub
sources.snippet: 🧠 Explainable AI for Alzheimer's MRI Classification An industry-grade deep learning diagnostic tool built to classify stages of Alzheimer's disease from MRI scans. This project prioritizes clinical trust by featuring mathematically weighted loss functions and visual interpretability using HiResCAM.
